purpose: Development-only tire-mismatch attribution; no policy/gate tuning or training
branches: At common sampled states clone plant+observer, hold each ramp-allowed fused command for5ticks, then common estimated-state nominal LQR continuation. Use paired actual future sensor-noise realization OFFLINE ONLY to measure cost differences. Hidden plant parameters only in plant, never gate.
metrics: Gate-compatible tracking/yaw/effort plus terminal cost AND lateral squared cost; report separately. Gate predictor always original20tick nominal linear/local-curvature model; compare its deltas with20tick realized matching-cost deltas. Compare lateral benefit signs across20/40/100ticks, not numerical costs across horizons.
shadow: Each candidate maintains its own shadow Gate updated every tick along common LQR/student trajectory, not a counterfactual deployed rollout. Sampled prior ramp state defines three allowed blended proposals. Separate cost rejection from persistence/age/envelope.
threshold: Meaningful benefit/harm >max(1e-7,1% of same-branch baseline cost), independently for gate-compatible and lateral costs. Report denominators and neutral cases. Correlated ticks are not independent trials.
stop: Only8 behavior trajectories. No authority increase, optimized replacement, final-test access, model selection, full training or native claim. Actual future noise is privileged diagnostic evidence, not teacher input or deployable performance.
